claim: Open source project management system for non-project managers
Kanban, gantt, table, list and calendar views; sprints; milestones; timesheets; goals; canvases; wikis; idea boards
All listed features are included in the OSS version
PHP 8.2+, MySQL 8.0+ or MariaDB 10.6+, Apache or Nginx (IIS with modifications)
Required PHP extensions include LDAP, PCNTL, bcmath, GD
Install via release zip or official Docker image
LDAP and OIDC integration, two-factor authentication, per-project permissions
File storage via S3 or local filesystem
Leantime Pro is sold at $10 per user per month, billed monthly
Reverse proxy setups need extra environment variables in Docker
